verdict.rationale: FreeAgent is a SaaS accounting product, so the data region and residency question applies to it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any choice of storage region or any data-residency control. The only location-related evidence is the sandbox vs production API endpoints and UK/HMRC filing features. Neither is user-selectable data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
